title: PseudonymEpochRotated
description: The pseudonym epoch advanced for a tenant and domain. Pseudonyms from different epochs are unlinkable by the same argument that makes domains unlinkable, which caps the window over which any one domain can build a longitudinal profile. Systems MUST NOT attempt to bridge epochs locally. Carries no pseudonym.

domain.description: Domain whose keys were re-derived. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

effective_at.description: When the new epoch took effect.

pseudonyms_rotated.description: Count of pseudonyms re-derived. A count, not a list.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
